coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 6 of 11 ground-truth items (55%): all three required prompting methods and all three tasks. The four required constant-variable items and the exact dependent-variable definition are not matched.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Does not specify the NVIDIA A100-PCIE-40GB GPU, fixed random seeds, or the shared framework installation and BoT repository configuration. Uses six trials rather than 10 repeated runs per task. Measures per-instance latency in seconds and proposes a logarithmic analysis, but does not specify the required base-10 logarithmic inference-time metric. Adds CoT and several auxiliary outcomes beyond the target design.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Provides neither the expected overall increase in BoT inference time nor the task-specific logarithmic timing results, including the Game of 24 exception where BoT is faster than PAL.
